A type of '''transport''' was seen to be used by [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the year [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] was unshielded and did not possess armaments. One participated in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle to retake Theed]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. It carried three [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]. That speeder was escorted by [[Group 3]], and met up with [[Group 2]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] at the [[Theed Courthouse]]. Sykes and the others escorted the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to a gate blocking their way to the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]], where it disgorged the commandos so they could blow the gate.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The transport appears only in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
